user_reported_bug: Phase 2D previous bug-test iteration found 2 issues after the initial parity restoration: (1) `Link` was missing from imports in customer JobDetail.jsx, so bid cards with the new driver-profile link would crash. (2) DriverProfilePublic page rendered a misleading 'Profile not found' when hit unauthenticated because GET /api/users/:id/profile requires auth. Both frontend-only fixes were just applied — Link imported; DriverProfilePublic now distinguishes 401 from not-found and shows a sign-in CTA (dpp-signin-required / dpp-signin-cta). Backend remains untouched: the endpoint's auth requirement matches the Expo source flow (in-app profile view from authenticated customer context).
